camel_example: aliyun iot GetGatewayBySubDevice --region cn-hangzhou --IotId Q7uOhVRdZRRlDnTLv000000100 --IotInstanceId 'iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000' --ProductKey a1BwAGV0000 --DeviceName light
description_en: Queries the information about a gateway device based on the mounted sub-device information
description_zh: 根据挂载的子设备信息查询对应的网关设备信息
kebab_example: aliyun iot get-gateway-by-sub-device --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --product-key a1BwAGV0000 --device-name light --iot-id Q7uOhVRdZRRlDnTLv000000100 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetGatewayBySubDevice

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If an ID value is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no<props="intl"><ph> Overview page or</ph></props> ID value is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无<props="intl"><ph>实例概览页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the sub-device belongs.
If you specify this parameter, you must also specify DeviceName
parameters.help_zh:
子设备所隶属的产品ProductKey。
如果传入该参数，需同时传入DeviceName
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The device name of the sub-device.
If you specify this parameter, you must also specify ProductKey
parameters.help_zh:
子设备名称。
如果传入该参数，需同时传入ProductKey
parameters.name: device_name

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the sub-device. This is the unique identifier issued by IoT Platform for the sub-device.
If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify ProductKey or DeviceName. IotId is the globally unique identifier of the device and corresponds to a combination of ProductKey and DeviceName. If you specify both IotId and the combination of ProductKey and DeviceName, IotId takes precedence
parameters.help_zh:
子设备ID。物联网平台为该子设备颁发的ID，设备的唯一标识符。
如果传入该参数，则无需传入ProductKey和DeviceName。IotId作为设备唯一标识符，和ProductKey与DeviceName组合是一一对应的关系。如果您同时传入IotId和ProductKey与DeviceName组合，则以IotId为准
parameters.name: iot_id

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

Data.description_en: The details of the gateway device returned if the call was successful
Data.description_zh: 调用成功时，返回的网关设备的详细信息

DeviceName.description_en: The device name of the gateway device

DeviceSecret.description_en: The device secret of the gateway device

FirmwareVersion.description_en: The firmware version of the gateway device
FirmwareVersion.description_zh: 网关设备的固件版本号

GmtActive.description_en: The activation time of the gateway device in GMT. This is the local time of the user
GmtActive.description_zh: 网关设备的激活时间，GMT格式，是用户所在地的当地时间

GmtCreate.description_en: The creation time of the gateway device in GMT. This is the local time of the user
GmtCreate.description_zh: 网关设备的创建时间，GMT格式，是用户所在地的当地时间

GmtOnline.description_en: The most recent time when the gateway device went online, in GMT. This is the local time of the user
GmtOnline.description_zh: 网关设备最近一次上线的时间，GMT格式，是用户所在地的当地时间

IpAddress.description_en: The IP address of the gateway device

NodeType.description_en: The node type. The value is 1, which indicates that the device is a gateway device
NodeType.description_zh: 节点类型，取值为1，表示该设备为网关设备

ProductKey.description_en: The ProductKey of the product to which the gateway device belongs

ProductName.description_en: The name of the product to which the gateway device belongs
ProductName.description_zh: 网关设备隶属的产品名称

Status.description_en:
The status of the gateway device. Valid values:
online: The device is online.
offline: The device is offline.
unactive: The device is not activated.
disable: The device is disabled
Status.description_zh:
网关设备状态。取值：
online：设备在线。
offline：设备离线。
unactive：设备未激活。
disable：设备已禁用

UtcActive.description_en: The activation time of the gateway device in UTC. You can calculate the local time based on the time zone difference
UtcActive.description_zh: 网关设备的激活时间，UTC格式，世界标准时间。用户所在地实际时间，可根据当地时差计算

UtcCreate.description_en: The creation time of the gateway device in UTC. You can calculate the local time based on the time zone difference
UtcCreate.description_zh: 网关设备的创建时间，UTC格式，世界标准时间。用户所在地实际时间，可根据当地时差计算

UtcOnline.description_en: The most recent time when the gateway device went online, in UTC. You can calculate the local time based on the time zone difference
UtcOnline.description_zh: 网关设备最近一次上线的时间，UTC格式，世界标准时间。用户所在地实际时间，可根据当地时差计算

iotId.description_en: The ID issued by IoT Platform for the gateway device. This serves as the unique identifier of the device
iotId.description_zh: 物联网平台为该网关设备颁发的ID，作为该设备的唯一标识符

region.description_en: The region where the gateway device is located. This corresponds to the region displayed in the console
region.description_zh: 网关设备所在地域（与控制台上的地域对应）

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
表示是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
